lcc_original: 於是永恆主上帝用那人身上取下來的肋骨建造一個女人，帶她到那人跟前。
notes: 耶和華神 (two words) → 永恆主上帝 (two words): 永恆主 carries WH03068 (YHWH), 上帝 carries WH0430 (Elohim); LCC systematically uses 上帝 where UNV uses 神
WAH0834 (relative particle אשר, on UNV 所) mapped to LCC 的, which serves the same post-verbal relativizer function in the 取下來的 construction
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit: LCC has no explicit direct-object marker word, placed before 肋骨 to match its Hebrew position (את before the noun)
造成 → 建造 (synonym, same WH01129+WTH8799)
領她 → 帶她 (both mean 'bring/lead', same WH0935+WTH8686)
於是 left unannotated — Chinese discourse connective with no Hebrew lexical equivalent
